    Monomial presentations and bands #

    The data form (3′) of Theorem 3.10 for a monomial presentation. Let π : kQ → B be surjective with kernel spanned by the words of a set P of paths (for a monomial ideal I, the paths lying in I). Let p : D_w → Q be the cycle of a primitive cyclically reduced closed walk such that no directed path of D_w has its label word in P ("no directed segment of a power of the walk lies in I"). Then every p_*L(T) is a B-module, so the walk gives walk data (Walk.MonomialBand.toWalkData).

    The key computation (pdAct_word_blk): a block e_j · w · e_i of the action of a path w on a push-down is nonzero only if w lifts to a directed path of D from i to j.

      structure LargeIndecomposable.Walk.MonomialBand (k : Type u) [Field k] (B : Type u) [Ring B] [Algebra k B] :
      Type (max 1 u)

      Alternative (3′) of Theorem 3.10 for a monomial presentation: a presentation π : kQ → B whose kernel is spanned by the words of a set P of paths, and the cycle of a primitive cyclically reduced closed walk none of whose directed paths has its label word in P.

      • n : ℕ

        The cycle has n + 2 vertices.

      • ε : Fin self.n → Bool

        The orientations of the middle arrows.

      • Q : FinQuiver

        The quiver of the presentation.

      • p : (cycleQuiver self.n self.ε).Hom self.Q

        The map from the cycle to Q.

      • locInj : self.p.LocallyInjective
      • primitive : FinQuiver.Primitive self.p (cycleCoords self.n self.ε)
      • π : FinQuiver.PathAlgebra k self.Q →ₐ[k] B

        The presentation.

      • surj : Function.Surjective ⇑self.π
      • P : Set (List self.Q.A)

        The paths in the kernel.

      • ker_le (z : FinQuiver.PathAlgebra k self.Q) : self.π z = 0 → z ∈ Submodule.span k (FinQuiver.word k self.Q '' self.P)
      • band (le : List (cycleQuiver self.n self.ε).A) (i j : (cycleQuiver self.n self.ε).V) : FinQuiver.PathFrom i le j → List.map self.p.arr le ∉ self.P
